php_runtime_processes.query: SELECT pid,parent,name,path,uid FROM processes WHERE name LIKE 'php%' OR name LIKE 'lsphp%' OR name IN ('frankenphp','sw-engine-fpm','httpd','apache2');
php_runtime_processes.description: Candidates including non-PHP Apache; no command line or environment

php_listening_ports.query: SELECT p.pid,p.name,l.address,l.port,l.protocol FROM processes p JOIN listening_ports l ON p.pid=l.pid WHERE p.name LIKE 'php%' OR p.name LIKE 'lsphp%' OR p.name IN ('frankenphp','httpd','apache2');
php_listening_ports.description: Local listeners only; no active scan

php_socket_review.query: SELECT p.pid,p.name,s.local_address,s.local_port,s.remote_address,s.remote_port FROM processes p JOIN process_open_sockets s ON p.pid=s.pid WHERE (p.name LIKE 'php%' OR p.name LIKE 'lsphp%' OR p.name='frankenphp') AND s.remote_port>0;
php_socket_review.description: Connections require baseline; no maliciousness verdict
